title: Q.ANT shows photonic NPU Gen 2+ offloading attention layers with AMD GPU
summary: Q.ANT demonstrated heterogeneous LLM inference at SC26, using its thin-film lithium niobate photonic NPU Gen 2+ to compute optical discrete Fourier transforms alongside an AMD Instinct accelerator.
research_notes:
Simulate optical discrete Fourier transform operations locally using Q.ANT's open-source SDK in Python or C before deploying to physical photonic hardware.

Install the Q.ANT NPU Gen 2+ co-processor into a standard PCIe slot within a server equipped with an AMD Instinct host GPU.

Partition model execution by mapping Fourier-transformable attention layers to the photonic NPU while retaining remaining dense and memory-bound layers on the host GPU.

Validate Fourier-transformed neural network layer replacements against baseline attention mechanisms in CPU simulation to measure model accuracy degradation before physical offload.

Target models with sequence-length bottlenecks where optical single-pass Fourier transforms yield maximum latency and energy benefits over electronic quadratic attention.
